messages:
Mira Patel: Hi all — first week setup question. My headset audio works (I can hear people) but the mic is not detected when plugged into the company USB-C dock. If I plug the headset straight into the laptop jack it works fine. Dock is the Anker USB-C 12-in-1 that came in my desk kit. Filed IT-3421 but wanted to ask here first. Anyone seen this?

Jordan (IT): Welcome Mira! Quick ones — what OS are you on, and can you check System Settings -> Sound -> Input to see if the headset shows up at all? Also try a different USB-C port on the dock if there are multiple.

Mira Patel: macOS Ventura 13.5.1. I checked System Settings -> Sound -> Input and nothing shows up when headset is in dock. When plugged direct the headset shows up as "HyperWave USB Headset" and input level meter moves. Tried the other USB-C port on the dock, same result.

Jordan (IT): Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) Can you run Apple menu -> About This Mac -> System Report -> USB and paste the USB tree entry for the dock (or screenshot)? 2) If you have a moment, try the headset in the dock on a different machine (if Sam can bring another laptop to your desk) to rule out dock hardware.

Mira Patel: Paste from System Report (USB section):
```
Anker USB-C Dock:
  Product ID: 0x1234
  Vendor ID: 0x0b05 (Anker Innovations)
  Manufacturer: Anker
  Speed: Up to 480 Mb/s
  Audio Interface: not enumerated for input
```

Jordan (IT): That line "Audio Interface: not enumerated for input" is the clue — the dock isn't exposing the headset's capture device. Likely firmware/firmware handshake issue or hub mode. Quick steps:
- Try a different cable between dock and laptop (some USB-C cables are power-only).
- If you have the dock firmware updater (Anker Driver), try running it (we can push if needed).
- As a workaround you can plug the headset directly and we can swap the dock if the hardware is flaky.

Mira Patel: Tried a different USB-C cable from the kit — still no input. Headset mic works direct.

Sam (Workspace Ops): @Jordan I can drop by Mira's desk in ~20m and try the dock on another laptop. If it's the dock, we can swap it for a spare. Mira — what's your desk number?

Mira Patel: Desk D5. Thanks Sam!

it-bot: IT ticket IT-3421 updated: Assigned to Jordan (IT). Priority: P2. Added note: "Dock not exposing headset input; suspect dock firmware or cable."

Jordan (IT): Ok I pulled the spare dock from staging and tested — same headset on staging dock enumerates properly. Sam tried Mira's dock on another machine and reproduced the issue (no mic enumerated). Looks like Mira's dock is defective. Sam, please create a swap ticket and mark it as exchange with asset tag ANK-0487.

Sam (Workspace Ops): Will do. Replacements are in shipping; I can swap at your desk this afternoon (ETA 1400). I'll also include a spare USB-C cable.

Alex Chen: Welcome, Mira — sorry about the hiccup. @Sam thanks for the quick help. Mira, LMK if you want me to jump on a test call when you have the replacement. :thumbsup:

Mira Patel: Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast triage. I'll wait for Sam's swap and test again.

Jordan (IT): Logging resolution steps in ticket: swap defective dock ANK-0487, test audio, if issue persists escalate to vendor for RMA. Closing thread here but ticket will track. :white_check_mark:"
